messages:
sam_runtime: Heads drifting in prod after kernel-selector v3 deploy. qwen2.5, seq_len ~2k, seeing kv-head mismatch + tokenizer CJK splits. p95 latency up ~2.5x. short dump below.

sam_runtime: repro flags: --batcher=auto --kernel-hint=heuristic-v2 --route=asia-east

maria_ml: can you paste the small perf snippet + which shard layout? also are we hitting Rope-scale vs ALiBi path? :thinking:

sam_runtime: shard: s3, heads=32 kv_heads=16? (weird, runtime reported kv_heads=16 while model metadata says 32). tokenizer example shows splits: "北京" -> ["北","京"], increasing token count for CJK.

lee_gpu: profiler sample (trimmed):
```
route: asia-east / model: qwen2.5
seq: 2048, batch: 4
kernel chosen: auto_kernel_v3 (attention_fused=false)
KV cache layout: alloc 0x7f.. size=12GB (per-shard expected 24GB)
per-step latency (ms): 1:8 5:9 10:12 50:18 95:120 99:210
fallbacks: autokernel->scalar_attention on long seqs
notes: kv_head_mismatch detected when kv_heads != attn_heads -> extra memcpy in KV index path
```

jon_bisect: did quick bisect, suspect change f2a3b7c introduced in kernel-selector refactor swapped fallback ordering. reproduces locally with minimal script.

ana_infra: (ana_infra): try disabling continuous batching for that route as a quick mitigation: set batcher.window_ms=0 for canary. also consider enforcing kv_head_force_align=true.

maria_ml: kv_head_force_align often helps when model metadata is wrong. also try forcing tokenizer pre-tokenize for CJK to compare counts.

sam_runtime: applying kv_head_force_align and forcing kernel hint to "legacy-fused-attn" on canary now. will push revert of selector if still bad.

perfbot: [ALERT] route=asia-east qwen2.5 p95 increased 2.4x at 1755554200, tagging owners: @sam_runtime @lee_gpu. Auto-canary status: running.

lee_gpu: if revert fixes latency, we should add a unit test: compare model-metadata.kv_heads vs runtime-detected.kv_heads and fail fast. Also add tokenization regression test for CJK roundtrip.

jon_bisect: filing small follow-up PR to restore previous fallback ordering and add assertion. commit f2a3b7c -> revert PR queued.

sam_runtime: revert applied to canary -> p95 back to baseline within 10m. will schedule full prod rollback + postmortem. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria_ml: follow-up items: 1) add kv_head alignment check in model loader 2) add tokenizer CJK fuzz test 3) add perf regression alert linked to kernel selector changes.

perfbot: [INFO] incident created: INC-2026-0092. linking to rollback PR #4321.

lee_gpu: leaving note: kernel-selector-v3 needs a special-case for qwen2.5 when metadata kv_heads missing or mismatched; also consider a cheap heuristic: if tokenizer increases token count >10% for known CJK inputs, prefer fused-attn path.

sam_runtime: noted. will own postmortem and assign the three follow-ups.
